## Common Aggregations

### 入口级 ADS vs Organic 分流 (Core Pattern)

这是该表最核心的使用模式，在所有下游 workflow 中重复出现：

```sql
SELECT
  grass_region,
  user_id,
  common_feature,
  app_version,
  item_id,
  location,
  shop_id,
  -- Ads 曝光
  SUM(CASE WHEN common_property.is_ads = true AND operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_ads_cnt,
  -- Organic 曝光
  SUM(CASE WHEN (common_property.is_ads != true OR common_property.is_ads IS NULL) AND operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_organic_cnt,
  -- 总曝光
  SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_cnt,
  -- Ads 点击
  SUM(CASE WHEN common_property.is_ads = true AND operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_ads_cnt,
  -- Organic 点击
  SUM(CASE WHEN (common_property.is_ads != true OR common_property.is_ads IS NULL) AND operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_organic_cnt,
  -- 总点击
  SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_cnt
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_scenario_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND user_id > 0
  AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
GROUP BY grass_region, user_id, common_feature, app_version, item_id, location, shop_id
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. Organic Metrics Entry Point View (workflows/dws/organic)

```sql
-- Build omni_entry_point_operation view
-- Source: dws_organic_metrics_1d__reg_s0_live workflow
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW omni_entry_point_operation AS
SELECT grass_region, user_id, common_feature, app_version, item_id, location, shop_id, entry_point,
    platform, rn_version, scenario, page_type, page_section, target_type, module, feature_detail, feature_group, feature, object,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_ads_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_organic_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_ads_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_organic_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT platform, rn_version, search_property.scenario AS scenario, page_type, page_section, target_type, module, feature_detail, feature_group, feature, object,
    operation, user_id, common_property.is_ads AS is_ads, grass_region, shop_id,
    CASE WHEN app_version IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE app_version END AS app_version,
    CASE WHEN item_id IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE item_id END AS item_id,
    CASE WHEN location_property.location IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE location_property.location END AS location,
    CASE -- common_feature mapping (14+ branches)
      WHEN (feature_detail LIKE '%-shop_item' AND feature_group = 'Search') OR feature_detail = 'search-shop' THEN 'Search Shop'
      WHEN module = 'Image Search' THEN 'Image Search'
      WHEN feature_group = 'You May Also Like' THEN 'You May Also Like'
      -- ... more branches ...
      ELSE 'Others'
    END AS common_feature,
    CASE -- entry_point mapping (10+ branches)
      WHEN page_type = 'search' AND page_section IS NULL AND target_type IN ('item', 'video', 'livestream', 'related_search') THEN 'Global Search'
      -- ... more branches ...
      ELSE 'Undefined'
    END AS entry_point
  FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_scenario_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
  WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
    AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
    AND tz_type = 'local'
    AND user_id > 0
    AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
) GROUP BY grass_region, user_id, common_feature, app_version, item_id, location, shop_id, entry_point,
    platform, rn_version, scenario, page_type, page_section, target_type, module, feature_detail, feature_group, feature, object;
```

```sql
-- Build omni_entry_point_operation for AB test

-- Simplified version (no entry_point/step_type, fewer dimensions)

  SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_ads_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_organic_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_impr_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_ads_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_organic_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_entry_click_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT operation, user_id, common_property.is_ads AS is_ads, grass_region, shop_id,
    CASE WHEN app_version IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE app_version END AS app_version,
    CASE WHEN item_id IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE item_id END AS item_id,
    CASE WHEN location_property.location IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE location_property.location END AS location,
    CASE -- common_feature mapping
      WHEN (feature_detail LIKE '%-shop_item' AND feature_group = 'Search') OR feature_detail = 'search-shop' THEN 'Search Shop'
      -- ... same mapping ...
      ELSE 'Others'
    END AS common_feature
  FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_scenario_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
  WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
    AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
    AND tz_type = 'local'
    AND user_id > 0
    AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
) GROUP BY grass_region, user_id, common_feature, app_version, item_id, location, shop_id;
```

| Derived Metric | Formula | Type |
|---------------|---------|------|
